snippet.title: Mike's POV History
snippet.description:
I’ve always been drawn to history. Not just the big events, but the feeling of living through them. The places people walked, the moments they stood in, the ordinary days happening alongside world-changing ones.

Recently, I started using AI as a tool to reconstruct those moments visually. Not to rewrite history or sensationalise it, but to help bridge the gap between then and now — to see the past from ground level, as if you were really there.

This channel is about exploring history through a personal point of view. Reconstructing scenes, environments, and perspectives that help make historical moments feel tangible, human, and easier to connect with.

No gimmicks. Just history, brought a little closer to the present.

snippet.title: The Incredible Journey
snippet.description:
The Incredible Journey is a donor-funded ministry sharing the good news of Christ and preparing people for the soon coming of Jesus.

We are devoted to giving Biblical answers to life’s questions through television, the Internet, social media, Bible Centre, evangelistic ministry and Christian living and faith-sharing resources.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey media ministry. He holds a B.A. in Theology, M.A. in Ancient History & Archaeology, and M. in Divinity. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan.

We travel to the ends of the earth to provide Biblical answers to life’s most difficult questions. Our independent productions are broadcast on 9Gem (Australia), TVNZ (New Zealand), GEB, Positiv TV, TBN Inspire (USA) and 3ABN.

Join us as we investigate history, the Bible, including the prophecies of Daniel and Revelation and share the hope of the imminent return of Jesus.

Home of The Incredible Journey with Gary Kent.

snippet.title: The People Profiles
snippet.description:
Established in 2018 by Edwin Elliott, The People Profiles was the first long-form independent documentary channel on YouTube. With detailed, politically neutral, meticulously researched scripts, all written by qualified and award-winning historians, narrators and video editors with years of experience in both video production and film. The team at The People Profiles prides itself on being the gold standard for attention to detail, accuracy, quality, as well as unbiased, fair and factual biographies of famous and infamous people in history.

As of 2026, all People Profiles scripts are written, narrated and edited by human beings and our thumbnails are based on real paintings, statues and photographs of each historical figure, to give you the most accurate image of them possible. 

"All human history essentially comes down to biography." Edwin Elliott

- Myths vs Reality: what Hollywood got wrong

⚓ Subscribe and join the crew. Or walk the plank.

snippet.title: History Dose
snippet.description:
Two brothers, Chris the history grad and Joe the artist, team up to capture the wonder, terror, and beauty of the past. Chris holds a B.A. with honors in history from Cornell University (2018). He writes and narrates each script and posts a bibliography of academic sources in each video description, including fully footnoted scripts so that interested viewers may source specific claims and learn more. Joe is a digital artist who manually creates each piece with a stylus and pad, honing his craft in the medium since 2017. Together, we are History Dose®. 

If our content clicks with you, please consider making a pledge at our Patreon. Every dollar helps, and memberships give you access to certain rewards: bonus episodes, behind-the-scenes interactions, Discord access and more.

snippet.title: The Frozen Town
snippet.description:
The Frozen Town
Where the coldest places on Earth tell the warmest stories.
Life doesn't stop at –61°C — it finds a way to burn brighter.
Welcome to The Frozen Town, your window into the raw, breathtaking world of Oymyakon, Oleneksky, Yukon and the most remote polar regions on the planet. Here, we go beyond the cold to uncover the community, tradition, and resilience that make these frozen worlds pulse with life.
What you'll find here:
Life-inspired stories from Oymyakon and the polar regions
The culture, spirit, and traditions that survive the harshest winter


DISCLAIMER: The videos on this channel are not documentaries. All scenes are created using artificial intelligence technologies and are entirely fictional, produced for storytelling and atmospheric purposes only. Interactions with wild animals depicted in these videos are fictional and should not be replicated or interpreted as appropriate ways to interact with wild animals in real life.
